senses.gloss:
ENRAPTURE, ENRAVISH: प्रहर्षयति (c. of हृष्):
v. To charm.

ENRICH:
I Lit.: धनिनं (f. नीं)
or
धनशालिनं (f.
नीं) करोति: v. Rich, to make.
II To adorn:
q. v.: मण्डयति (c. of मण्ड्).
III To fertilize:
q. v.

ENRICHMENT: expr. by circumlo.: v. To
enrich.

ENROLL (v.):
I To enlist: *निवेशपत्रिकायां नाम
 निवेशयति (c. of विश्).
II To record: q. v.
III To envelop: q. v.

ENROLLMENT:
I The act: *नामनिवेशनम्।
II
A register: *निवेशपत्रिका।
